solution.title: Workspace ONE to Intune — Policy & Compliance Translation

products.name: Workspace ONE to Intune — Policy & Compliance Translation — Commercial
products.short_description: A repeatable way to translate Workspace ONE policies and compliance into Intune — inventory source policy, map it to the settings catalog/configuration/compliance per platform, handle what doesn't translate, and validate parity before cutover. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Translate every Workspace ONE profile and compliance rule into Intune — with proven parity

The settings are the soul of an MDM migration: every Workspace ONE configuration profile and compliance policy has to be translated into Intune — settings catalog, configuration profiles, and compliance policy — with the same effective posture, or devices quietly become less secure (or break). This solution gives you a repeatable way to translate Workspace ONE policies and compliance into Intune: inventory source policy, map it to Intune across platforms, handle what doesn't translate, and validate parity before cutover.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the policy-translation model, mapping Workspace ONE profiles/compliance to Intune (settings catalog, configuration profiles, compliance policy) per platform, handling unsupported settings, and the parity-validation gate.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, Workspace ONE policy export/inventory, per-platform mapping targets, a pilot group, change control) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: inventory source profiles/compliance, map supported settings to Intune per platform, handle unsupported settings and exceptions, assign to a pilot, validate parity, then expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — source policy/compliance discovery, source-vs-Intune parity validation, a translation coverage and gap report, safe remediation of policy conflicts, and a policy-scope group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every Workspace ONE profile and compliance rule translated into Intune with proven parity — the same effective security posture across platforms, gaps handled deliberately — so nothing silently weakens at cutover, proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • WS1POL-Discovery.ps1 — normalize a Workspace ONE policy/compliance export into a per-platform inventory
    • WS1POL-Remediation.ps1 — find and (with confirmation) resolve conflicting policy assignments
    • WS1POL-Report.ps1 — per-policy and per-device configuration + compliance state (Microsoft Graph)
    • WS1POL-Set-PolicyScopeTargeting.ps1 — create/populate the policy-scope Entra groups for staged assignment
    • WS1POL-Validation.ps1 — parity check between the Workspace ONE source inventory and deployed Intune policy

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
